purpose: First complete real-provider capability acceptance, then measure a bounded cache/cost/quality pilot.
authorization: User explicitly requested real model requests, completion of stage two, then stage three.
target: Bundled official Host in a temporary synthetic workspace; existing DeepSeek official credential reference only.

primaryMetric.name: estimated CNY per correct synthetic answer
primaryMetric.guard: Objective exact JSON equality; report failures and unknown costs.

secondaryMetrics: cache-read share when all prompt buckets are known

model.accounting: Use observed response model and usage; never infer cache hits from identical hashes.

stageTwo: real file read with Skills absent
real Skill invocation and file read

stageThree.order: blocked by arm, task-00 then task-0f; report this order limitation
stageThree.temperature: not changed; no deterministic-output or statistical-significance claim
stageThree.coldCache: unknown; first observed request is not asserted cold

followupV2.reason: Both arms returned the correct stable-deduplication values under different property names (answer or key_values), rather than values. Preserve both original strict failures and test an explicit JSON property name.
followupV2.intendedChange: Question wording; fixed expected values remain unchanged.
followupV2.environmentalDifference: A new isolated workspace is created. Its path and system prefix also change, so this is not a single-variable cache or causal-quality experiment.

secrets: No headers, credential values, or raw authentication errors in receipts. Remove the temporary credential file in finally.
retention: Keep failed and successful receipts separately; do not replace failed evidence with a corrected result.

audit.attribution: Wait for all in-flight audit records to settle and persist before each turn boundary.
audit.legacyPolicy: Keep original receipts and provisional summaries; incomplete terminal observation means unknown cost and unverified cache aggregates. Rerun with v2 for formal measurement.

stop: Stop on stage-two acceptance failure, request/output budget, unresolved permission, transport failure, or timeout. Do not start stage three until stage two passes.
scopeLimit: Small synthetic pilot measures these requests only. It does not establish engineering-task success, general modeling quality, an account bill, or a universal speed/cost improvement.
